scope: First planning milestone; not a completed Unity game or verified commercial forecast.

theme.premise: 밤에 잠긴 종탑의 세 종을 깨워 아침을 되찾는다.

combat.normalAttack: Can deal normal damage during enemy patterns; dodge cancels unlanded attacks without refunding the attack cooldown.
combat.echo: One charge from a perfect dodge. No stacking. Must avoid every hit in that pattern. Any damage clears it and blocks reacquisition in that pattern. Ready only after final hit; consumption requires a landed attack within 800ms. Clear on expiry, enemy defeat, next pattern, or run exit.
combat.pause: Freeze combat clock; if resuming by restarting a telegraph, clear echo and mark the record interrupted.
combat.timingStatus: Initial test values, not measured device thresholds.

releaseTarget.condition: Expand only after fun test and affordable asset estimate.

content.runEstimateStatus: Analytic scenario using assumed skill; not playtest result.

story.endingPlayback: First clear only, after the run record is finalized; excluded from run time. Skippable and free to replay in settings.

visual.artifactStatus: Generated concept, not verified production pixels.
visual.hud: Enemy telegraphs above thumb area. Echo uses attack button icon/border; no separate management gauge.
visual.layoutOwner: UI review's bounds and anchors supersede combat review's illustrative layout.
visual.copy: Only actions, necessary state, brief narrative, purchase conditions and recovery. No implementation commentary in game UI.

economy.failure: Keep rewards for completed encounters only; no reward just for dying.

economy.priceStatus: Planning assumptions; actual display price comes from store.
economy.contentExhaustionRisk: All free unlocks cost 240: 10 full clears without ads, about 36 minutes under the analytic run assumption. Hide rewarded currency ads once no free unlock remains. D7 and ad participation may fall after collection.

business.forecastStatus: Hypothetical scenarios; no acquired audience or measured revenue.
business.strategy: Prototype first, external observation, limited soft launch. Do not scale paid UA without measured economics.
business.schedule: Three-week prototype assumption, followed by testing. Platform integration, policies and review are additional. The earlier 7-9 week release guess is superseded; actual availability is unknown.
